What is this?

A subverse where the submissions are petitions to change the subverse in some way. Users upvoat or downvoat petitions to vote on them, and make them law!

How does this work?

Each submission is a petition, it must detail some single clear change to the subverse. Then the submission goes to voting, where users can either upvoat (for/yea) or downvoat (against/nay) to determine if the petition passes and becomes law. If a submission has more upvoats than downvoats after 24 hours, it becomes law and the change it represents is carried out. If a petition has an equal number of upvoats and downvoats after 24 hours, the petition fails automatically.

What kinds of petitions can I submit?

Anything that changes the subverse in any way!

  • Nominate yourself or someone else to become moderator
  • Remove a moderator
  • Change the wording of a rule
  • Add a ridiculous rule like "Only submissions of cat pictures will be allowed on Tuesdays"
  • Overturn a ridiculous rule like "Only submissions of cat pictures will be allowed on Tuesdays"
  • Change the stylesheet for this subverse

and so on

ANY POSTS VIOLATING THE RULES IN THE SIDEBAR WILL BE REMOVED BY MODERATORS WITH A NOTE STATING WHY THE POST WAS REMOVED

Have fun, and happy voating!
